assets.name: Noise-front dissolve
assets.description: Entry: A noise threshold sweeps the grid; cells past it switch to the new subject. Exit: Old subject gone when the front passes.

assets.format: JSON transition spec (duration, phases, layer targets, easing) driven by the shared transition orchestrator
assets.layer_structure: Picture cells only; band untouched
assets.animation: Transition, timing: 800 ms; starts at the boundary.
assets.scene_compatibility: all ASCII and 1-bit scenes

assets.responsive_behaviour: Directions mirror in RTL; distances are relative to frame size
assets.performance: One extra subject map resident.
assets.acceptance_criteria: Never overlaps an active lyric unless the spec says so; reduced-motion variant reviewed (300 ms cross-fade.); deterministic in export (pure function of t); flash limits respected.
